resources.string: Transfer with your phone or computer
Scan the code with a phone in the same Wi-Fi. The page it opens fills in the PIN.
Or open this address in a browser and enter the PIN:

To import, choose the backup file on that page and send it: this TV then asks for the password of the backup, if it has one, and before it replaces anything. To get a backup from this TV, export below, then press Download on that page.
The transfer is not encrypted. Protect your backups with a password.
This TV has no network connection, so the transfer page is not available. Connect it to Wi-Fi or Ethernet and open this screen again.
Too many wrong PINs: the transfer page is closed. Leave this screen and open it again for a new PIN.
Ready to download: %1$s. Press Download on the transfer page.
QR code of the transfer address
Show backup files on this TV
Also look in the Download folder
Without storage access, CamGrid cannot read the Download folder.
